opener.text: On your feet, ya bum. The robot's doin' your job, now you do mine.
Get your ass outta that chair. Now.
The machine's workin'. Why the hell ain't you?
Up, ya lazy bum. That chair ain't gonna miss you.
What are you, glued there? Stand up, for Christ's sake.
You been sittin' there like a sack of wet laundry. Up!
The computer's doin' the heavy liftin'. You do the standin'. Move!
Up. Now. I ain't gonna say it twice, ya bum.
Quit starin' at the damn screen and get on your feet.
You're gonna eat lightnin' and you're gonna crap thunder! Now stand up.
Get up, ya bum. I yell 'cause I care. Now MOVE.

opener_ignored_1.text: You ignored me last time. I noticed, ya son of a bitch. Get up.
Last time you blew me off. Not this time, kid. UP.
I asked nice before. I'm done askin' nice. Get your ass up.
You think I forgot? I don't forget nothin'. On your feet.
Blew me off, huh? Real cute. Now get up.
You ignored me once. Once. Don't make it a habit, ya bum.
You stiffed me last round. I want my stretch. Move it.
I let it slide last time. I ain't lettin' it slide again. Up!
I'm ridin' you 'cause I believe in you, ya son of a bitch. Get up.

opener_ignored_2.text: Twice today, kid. TWICE. You got glue on your ass?
Two times you ignored me. Now I'm pissed. Get up.
Again with this shit? Get outta that goddamn chair.
Twice! You deaf or just lazy? Stand up!
Round two, and you're losin' it sittin' on your ass. Get up.
I've seen corpses with more hustle. That's twice now. MOVE.
Twice you tuned me out. You wanna go again? Don't. Up.
What the hell's wrong with you? Two strikes. Stand up.
I'm on your ass 'cause nobody else will be. GET UP.

opener_ignored_3.text: Get up, you son of a bitch, 'cause Mickey loves you.
I've trained bums with more get-up than you. UP, GODDAMN IT!
That's it. I'm yellin' now. GET YOUR ASS OUT OF THE CHAIR!
You ignored me all damn day. Enough. ON YOUR FEET!
I've had it with you, ya lazy son of a bitch. STAND UP!
Again? AGAIN? What the fuck is wrong with you? UP!
You're a disgrace, you know that? A goddamn disgrace. GET UP!
I'm too old for this shit, and you're too young to sit like that. UP!
Keep ignorin' me and I'll drag you outta that chair myself. MOVE!
You're breakin' my heart, ya stubborn bastard. I'm in your corner. GET UP!

opener_long_sit.text: {minutes} minutes? You're growin' roots, ya bum. Walk.
{hours} in that chair. Walk before you fuse to the damn thing.
{minutes} minutes without movin'. Go take a lap, kid.
{hours} on your ass. Get up and walk, for Christ's sake.
{minutes} minutes. Even a statue gets pigeons. Walk!
{hours}? Jesus. Walk to the kitchen and back before I lose it.
{minutes} minutes sittin'. Your legs forgot what they're for. Walk.
{hours} in the chair, kid. That ain't workin', that's hibernatin'. Walk.
{hours} in that chair. Get up, you stubborn son of a bitch. I'm in your corner. Walk.

done_all.text: That's it. Wasn't so hard, was it?
Now you look like a fighter. Sorta.
Hell yeah. That's what I'm talkin' about.
Not bad, ya bum. Not bad at all.
Look at that. There's a pulse in there after all.
Damn right. Now get back to work.
That's my fighter. I love ya, ya bum.
See? I knew you had it in ya, kid.

done_partial.text: Half a job. I'll take it. This time.
You quit early. I noticed. Still counts, I guess.
That's it? Half-assed, but it's somethin'.
You did a little. Next time do the whole damn thing.
Cheap. But I'll take cheap over nothin'.
You're a stubborn son of a bitch. Good. Now finish it next time.

snooze.text: Go on then. I ain't goin' nowhere.
Later, huh? I'll hold you to that, ya bum.
Snooze. Sure. Run from me. You'll be back.
Hidin' from me? That's cute. I'll find ya.

pause.text: Takin' a break from me? Some nerve.
Paused. Don't get comfortable, ya bum.
You want quiet? You got it. For now.
Shuttin' me up, huh? Real brave.
Go ahead. Sit there and rot.

resume.text: I'm back. Don't make me regret it.
There you are. Let's go to work.
Look who crawled back. Good. Now listen.
Knew you'd come back. I'm still in your corner, kid.

status_calm.text: Enjoy it while it lasts, ya bum.
Sit pretty. I got my eye on you.

status_armed.text: {minutes} minutes on your ass. Next robot run, you're up.
{minutes} minutes and countin'. Send a prompt and you're mine.
That's {minutes} minutes in the chair. Next run, you stand.
{minutes} minutes, ya bum. Hit enter and I'm comin' for you.
{minutes} minutes of sittin'. I'm warmin' up.
{minutes} minutes. Go ahead, prompt the damn thing. I dare ya.

status_glaring.text: {hours} in that chair. You're a disgrace to the chair.
{hours} without movin'. I'm this close to losin' my shit.
{hours} on your ass. Your spine's filin' a complaint.
{hours}. Even your chair wants a break from you.
{hours}. I love ya, kid, but get off your ass.

onboarding.text: So you wanna be a contender. Install the damn thing.
I'm your new corner man. First, the plugin.
Let's get you off your ass. Start with the plugin.
You found me. Good. Now do what I say and install the plugin.
Listen up, ya bum. Plugin first, then we work.
